methods.label: Compare the shortage and the remainder
methods.explanation:
Compare the two total bonus payments with the same company fund. Paying \(\$50\) per employee would require \(\$5\) more than the fund, while paying \(\$45\) per employee uses \(\$95\) less than the fund. Thus the total payments differ by
\[
5+95=100\text{ dollars}.
\]
Each employee's bonus was reduced by \(50-45=5\) dollars, so the number of employees is \(100\div5=20\).

The original fund was \(\$5\) short of twenty \(\$50\) bonuses, so it contained
\[
50\times20-5=995\text{ dollars}.
\]
Indeed, twenty \(\$45\) bonuses cost \(\$900\), leaving the stated \(\$95\). The answer is \(\$995\), choice E.
